basic_info.description: Beautifully remodeled single-family home with a legal ADU, perfect for homeowners or investors seeking rental income! Spacious backyard deck, ideal for entertaining or relaxing with family and friends    Experience the perfect blend of comfort and investment potential at 1182 Fitzgerald Ave. Don't miss out on this rare opportunity in the heart of San Francisco!
